items.why: In questions, was goes before she.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: I was wait backstage. → I was waiting backstage. | They was clapping. → They were clapping. | What she was doing? → What was she doing?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.label: Past progressive e when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para ações em andamento e when + passado simples para o evento curto: She was drinking tea when the manager came in.

facts.label: Em andamento
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para ações em andamento no passado: I was waiting backstage. They were clapping. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com you, we, they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para um evento curto: when the show started, when the manager came in. O evento curto fica no passado simples: She was drinking tea when the manager came in.
